t: Google open-weight language models that run on a local computer.
steps: Find the Gemma family page from Google DeepMind and read the terms.
Ask IT to approve a runtime such as Ollama or LM Studio.
Install the runtime on one teacher or lab machine.
Accept the Gemma Terms of Use.
Pull a Gemma model by name while online.
Choose a size that fits the computer.
Go offline and test a few classroom prompts.
